description: This file defines the ChatScreen widget for a Flutter app, implementing a chat interface with message display, suggestion chips, header elements, and input controls. It utilizes Provider for state management and includes UI elements such as a mascot, daily quiz section, and message bubbles.

classes.name: ChatScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a chat interface with headers, message list, suggestion chips, and input controls.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the chat screen, setting up listeners for the input controller to manage send button state.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _showDailyQuizSnack
methods.description: Displays a placeholder SnackBar for the Daily Quiz feature.

methods.name: _insertSuggestion
methods.description: Inserts a suggested prompt into the chat and scrolls to the bottom.

methods.name: _send
methods.description: Sends the text from the input field via the chat provider and clears the input.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the chat screen, including headers, message list, and input controls.
